text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I had my first dream of the new year.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother... I guess it's time to say 
goodbye."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big sis... I guess it's time for us to say 
goodbye.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"There's nothing left for Curren to do in 
this country. So Curren... has to go!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Every country waiting for the cute that 
Curren brings.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: In other words—the world, maybe?♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Cuteness pours down like a blessing of 
rain. ...Someday, it will reach you 
again...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll never forget the days I spent with 
you. So don't forget Curren either, okay, 
Big Brother?♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I won't forget the days I spent with you. 
So please remember Curren, too... okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And that's when I woke up. One Curren, 
two Currens, three Currens in my first 
dream of the year... Somehow, I feel like 
this year is going to be wild.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The new year. I was visiting the shrine 
for Hatsumode, invited by Curren Chan.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year~! Curren is so happy she 
gets to see Big Brother right at the start 
of the new year♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year~! Curren is so happy she 
gets to see Big Sister right at the start 
of the new year♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...? Weird big bro!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...? Weird big sis!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
By the way, about that favor~... Curren's 
all ears, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Because Curren already knows.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Your wish is about Curren... isn't it, Big 
Brother?♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Your wish has to do with Curren... doesn't 
it♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan had finally reached her Senior 
Year. I was just about to pray for her 
continued growth and success.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha♪ In that case, Curren will make it 
come true for you. What do you want Curren 
to become, Onii-chan?
choice_data_list: I just want you to stay healthy.
I want you to become a strong Umamusume.

I want you to have all kinds of weapons at 
your disposal

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha♪ In that case, Curren will make it 
come true for you. What do you want Curren 
to become, Onee-chan?
choice_data_list: I just want you to stay healthy.
I want you to become a strong Umamusume.

I want you to have all kinds of weapons at 
your disposal

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Is that all you want?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"I kind of thought you'd tell me to 'get 
stronger~' or 'run faster~'... and all 
that stuff."
choice_data_list:
All of that is only possible with good 
health.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You're so needy, Big Brother! Curren does 
love that about you, though—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You're so greedy, big sis / big brother! 
Curren kind of likes that about you, 
though—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I don't dislike it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Curren Chan took her time 
merrily looking around the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Heh...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Does that mean Curren should, like—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Tah!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...So you're saying you want it to feel 
like that?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, just kidding~♪ You mean getting 
stronger overall, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
With an important match coming up, Curren 
wants to get stronger just as much as you 
do.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best together as a team, 
Onii-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best together as a team, 
Onee-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... anything other than 
cute?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Oh, Curren might already have that 
one?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "Big Brother, close your eyes..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big sis, close your eyes~...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"You are my cute princess. One day, I will 
surely come for you..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: All do~ne♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, it's a secret~♪ Though this might 
actually be fun!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna think of other new weapons to 
use♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To formulate our plans for the year, we 
stopped by a karaoke box on the way back 
from Hatsumode at Curren Chan's 
suggestion. And then...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“—And so! The ‘Curren Chan's Cute Derby♪’ 
project is officially underway~♪”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Some kind of mysterious project, 
seemingly spearheaded by Curren Chan, was 
about to begin.
choice_data_list: What do you mean by that...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Alright, I'll explain it now, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Remember? At the end of the year, I 
introduced you to some girls who looked 
like they could become Curren's rivals, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Umamusume who all reign at the top of 
social media and also excel in the sprint 
division... Indeed, that was how they were 
introduced.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, facing the best lineup of runners, 
it would be a waste to just run normally.”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"If we're doing this, I want to create the 
biggest hype in sprint history... no, in 
all of racing history, and make everyone 
say sprints are number one!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So what Curren came up with is a project 
linking social media and racing: "Kawaii 
Derby♪"!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Here's the pitch for the campaign! 
"Champions of social media, stand your 
ground! Curren Chan challenges you with 
Uma-Likes on the line!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Nice," "Love it," "Fun"... They're 
universal reactions across all apps, 
showing positive emotions.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, it's a contest to see who 
can get the most "Umanes" against everyone 
with the top follower counts on social 
media! Please check the handouts for 
details~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The rules are simple. During the race 
period, we tally up the total number of 
'Umanes' on posts made from everyone's 
accounts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The number and content of posts do not 
matter. Once the post-race video comment 
is uploaded, the campaign submissions will 
officially conclude.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We will tally up all the "Uma-Likes" each 
post receives by 10:00 AM tomorrow, and 
whoever gets the most wins.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...In other words, the person who gets the 
most 'Uma-likes' is the most popular, most 
beloved Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It hypes up the sprint division while 
deciding who's number one. Killing two 
birds with one stone—a clear and simple 
plan, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, if it's visualized as numbers, 
picking number one should be easy. But 
there's just one thing bothering me...
choice_data_list:
Is it an advantage to have a lot of 
accounts?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Curren's been thinking about that 
too. The other girls haven't made accounts 
on all the platforms like Curren has."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"So as a precaution, I'm planning to 
include 'tally results per social media 
platform' too!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So if it's Umatter, we only use Umatter, 
right? That should make it fair, wouldn't 
you say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the flip side, managing so many 
accounts must make posting quite a 
hassle... Before I could point that out—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Listen, Big Brother! Curren is betting 
everything on this project!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Big Sis! Curren is putting 
everything on the line for this project!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
To walk the path of mastering cuteness, I 
cannot surrender the number one spot...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren will rise to the top amidst 
everyone's rapt attention. —To what lies 
beyond cute!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At that moment, I remembered how she 
looked in my first dream of the New 
Year...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having achieved the unification of 
cuteness, Curren Chan stood noble, and... 
radiated unmistakable cuteness.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Onii-chan, you probably just want 
Curren to focus on the race, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Big Brother definitely wants Curren to 
focus on the race, right?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, though, it won't affect the 
race. Besides... this project is just 
Curren being selfish. I'm not gonna ask 
you to tag along.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That's why—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the moment we signed the contract, my 
mind was made up. I want to see her 
conquer the world... with her cuteness!
choice_data_list:
I'm sure if it's you, you can become the 
champion.
I'm sure you can become a champion.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I just knew you'd say that, big 
brother.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I just knew you'd say that, big 
sister.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up helping out with the 
"Kawaii Derby♪" project, including 
tallying up the "Uma-Likes."
choice_data_list:
I'll reach out to the participants right 
away—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that's totally fine. I already got 
permission from everyone and the academy 
ages ago♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The details are all ironed out, so now all 
that's left is to announce it to my 
followers.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to everyone's reactions too, 
Big Brother♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Look forward to everyone's reaction too, 
Big Sis! ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...We've known each other a long time, 
but I still sense she doesn't fully rely 
on me. Even so, I decided I should at 
least be prepared."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Curren Chan's Cute Derby♪" is about to 
begin♪
